title: Trivago Hotel Scraper and Lead Finder input
description: Extract public Trivago hotel listing data by destination for hotel research, price comparison, market analysis, and lead-generation workflows.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: City, region, country, landmark, or a public Trivago destination URL. Examples: Amsterdam, London, Paris, Barcelona.

checkIn.title: Check-in date
checkIn.description: Optional check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The Actor returns this value in each row for downstream workflows. Trivago public listing pages may still show forecasted public prices instead of exact stay-date prices.

checkOut.title: Check-out date
checkOut.description: Optional check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after the check-in date when both are provided.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests to record with the run. Public Trivago SEO listing pages may not expose guest-specific live pricing.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Number of rooms to record with the run. Public Trivago SEO listing pages may not expose room-specific live pricing.

currency.title: Preferred currency
currency.description: Optional preferred currency code such as USD, EUR, or GBP. Trivago decides which currency is visible on the public page; the output includes the actual visible currency when available.

maxResults.title: Maximum hotel listings
maxResults.description: Maximum number of public hotel listing cards to return. Trivago destination pages commonly expose up to 35 public listing cards in the initial SEO page.

includePrices.title: Include prices
includePrices.description: Include public visible price fields when Trivago exposes them on listing cards.

includeBookingProviders.title: Include booking provider data
includeBookingProviders.description: Include public provider count and provider fields when visible. Trivago listing pages often expose provider counts, not individual provider names.

includeImages.title: Include images
includeImages.description: Include public hotel image URLs when available.

includeRatings.title: Include ratings
includeRatings.description: Include public guest rating, review count, and star rating fields when available.

includeAmenities.title: Include amenities and highlights
includeAmenities.description: Include public listing highlights and amenity-like text when visible on the listing card.

deduplicateResults.title: Deduplicate results
deduplicateResults.description: Remove duplicate hotels using Trivago accommodation IDs and URLs.

maxRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts for destination resolution and public listing page requests.
maxRetries.sectionDescription: Tune network behavior only when the default settings do not fit your use case.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each public Trivago request.

languageCode.title: Language code
languageCode.description: Trivago locale path used for public destination resolution.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for public Trivago pages. Residential proxies are recommended for cloud runs if Trivago blocks datacenter traffic.

debugMode.title: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Save debug HTML and parsed state to the key-value store when no listings are found or a request is blocked.
